title: Stage 5.4 Temporal Composition Stabilization — Development Smoke (TS-0 vs TS-1, EMA crop-center v1)
research_question: Do consecutive frozen CMP-1 crops show temporal position jumps, and can a deterministic crop-center smoothing reduce temporal jitter without an unacceptable regression in subject visibility?

in_scope: TS-0 = Stage 5.3 FINAL FROZEN CMP-1 crops (temporal control baseline, no smoothing)
TS-1 = deterministic EMA smoothing of the crop center (alpha = 0.5, development baseline fixed; no sweep this round)
temporal stability metrics (normalized displacement, acceleration; descriptive only)
spatial quality guardrails inherited from Stage 5.3 (visible fraction, visible >= 0.90, subject-center containment)
validate-only / dry-run / synthetic tests this round

ts0_definition.name: TS-0_frozen_cmp1
ts0_definition.definition: Stage 5.3 FINAL FROZEN CMP-1 per-frame crops (primary_subject_shifted_max_ratio_crop_v1), recomputed deterministically from the hash-verified frozen Stage 5.1/5.2 artifacts; fallback frames keep the frozen center crop

ts1_definition.name: TS-1_ema_crop_center_v1
ts1_definition.method: exponential moving average over the sanitized primary subject center (pre-clamp target of the frozen placement), re-placed each frame with the exact Stage 5.3 frozen floor/clamp convention and re-clamped into legal frame bounds
ts1_definition.alpha_policy: development baseline fixed at 0.5; no alpha sweep and no smoke-driven alpha selection in this round
ts1_definition.changed: temporal continuity of the crop center / placement only

reset_rules.new_video: state never crosses videos (one video per smoothing call)
reset_rules.frozen_temporal_segment_boundary: the frozen Stage 5.1/5.2 identity carries no segment ids; frozen temporal discontinuities are observable as frame-id gaps, so a segment boundary is handled by the frame-gap rule
reset_rules.frame_gap: reset when the gap between consecutive frozen frame ids is greater than 1
reset_rules.fallback: reset when the current or the previous frame is a frozen fallback frame (FALLBACK_CENTER_CROP); fallback frames always emit the frozen center crop and clear the EMA state
reset_rules.forbidden: no new pixel-level scene-cut detector in this round

geometry_contract.placement: EMA center re-placed with floor(center - crop/2) and clamped into [0, W-crop_w] x [0, floor(H - derived_h)] exactly as the frozen Stage 5.3 contract

temporal_stability.displacement: |cx_t - cx_(t-1)| / W; mean / median / P90 / P95 / max + large jump ratios
temporal_stability.comparison_set: paired transitions/triplets: consecutive frozen frames (gap == 1), both non-fallback; TS-1 smoothed-only subset reported separately
temporal_stability.role: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY / no promotion gate is derived from temporal metrics in v1

metrics.spatial_guardrails: mean visible fraction, visible >= 0.90, subject-center containment; TS-0 vs TS-1; large regression is unacceptable
metrics.strata: near / moderate / strong deltas; smoothing must not hurt off-center subjects
metrics.multi_subject: observation only; check whether TS-1 further degrades secondary retention vs TS-0

interpretation_boundary: Stage 5.4 is not 'the stronger the smoothing the better'; temporal jitter must decrease without an unacceptable subject-visibility regression
there is no official composition GT: no claim may be made that TS-1 improves the official competition score

smoke_manifest.sha_policy: built deterministically on the full frozen Dev166 frame identity by stage5_4_manifest, then SHA-frozen into configs/experiments/stage5/stage5_4_smoke.json before the smoke run; the smoke runner refuses to start while expected_manifest_sha256 is null
smoke_manifest.expected_scale: about 20-32 videos and 500-1500 frames depending on the real structure of the frozen dense sequences

all_must_pass: frame identity complete vs the frozen manifest (missing = 0, extra = 0, duplicate = 0)
TS-1 crop width equals TS-0 crop width on every frame
TS-1 derived height equals the exact target-ratio height on every frame
fallback frames emit the frozen center crop (placement unchanged)
TS-0 frozen regression = 0 (TS-0 equals the Stage 5.3 frozen CMP-1 semantics)

next_step_gate: Stage 5.4 Formal may only be preregistered after this smoke completes with all engineering gates PASS and guardrails reviewed
